1_A_Character.title: Your Customer Is the Hero
1_A_Character.description: Your customer is the hero of the story, not your brand. Define who they are—their desires, their challenges, and what they're trying to accomplish. The more clearly you understand your hero, the more effectively you can speak to them.

2_Has_a_Problem.title: Identify the Obstacles
2_Has_a_Problem.description: Every hero faces obstacles. Define the external problem (practical), internal problem (emotional), and philosophical problem (deeper meaning). A villain makes your story compelling—what is the thing standing between your customer and their success?

3_Meets_a_Guide.title: Your Brand as the Guide
3_Meets_a_Guide.description: Your brand is the guide—the mentor who helps the hero succeed. Establish empathy (you understand their struggle) and authority (you have a credible solution). The guide never steals the hero's spotlight but empowers them to win.

4_Who_Gives_Them_a_Plan.title: A Simple Path Forward
4_Who_Gives_Them_a_Plan.description: Give your customer a clear, step-by-step plan that reduces their confusion and fear. Break down the process into simple, digestible steps. An unambiguous plan removes friction and builds confidence in your solution.

5_That_Calls_Them_to_Action.title: The Call to Action
5_That_Calls_Them_to_Action.description: Invite your customer to take action. Use a direct CTA (e.g., 'Buy now') for those ready to commit, and a transitional CTA (e.g., 'Download our guide') for those who need more information. Make the next step obvious.

6_That_Ends_in_Success.title: Paint the Picture of Success
6_That_Ends_in_Success.description: Show your customer what life looks like after they choose your solution. Describe the transformation—the external, internal, and philosophical wins. Help them visualize the positive outcome and feel the relief of their problem solved.

7_And_Helps_Them_Avoid_Failure.title: The Stakes—What's at Risk
7_And_Helps_Them_Avoid_Failure.description: Clarify what happens if the customer doesn't act. What do they lose? What failure do they avoid by following your plan? Stakes create urgency and help customers understand why taking action matters now.
